parts.text: 刚才这次无写入探测在 PowerShell 解析阶段失败，HTTP 请求没有发出。我会改用内存中拼装 JSON 的写法，再验证同一个早期参数校验分支；不会重放原命令。

tool_input.description: Retry no-write guard probe with safe JSON body
tool_input.command: try { $captchaData = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $answerLines = @($captchaData.img | & node 'C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\captcha-recognizer\scripts\solve-captcha.mjs' '-'); $captchaAnswer = ($answerLines -join '').Trim(); if ($captchaAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$') { throw 'captcha solve produced no valid answer' }; $payload = '{"code":"' + $captchaAnswer + '","uuid":"' + $captchaData.uuid + '","tCyjgInfo":{}}'; $probeResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/company/base/createTempAccount' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payload -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $probeResult = $probeResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $probeMsg = [string]$probeResult.msg; $probeCategory = 'other'; if ($probeMsg -match '验证码') { $probeCategory = 'captcha-rejected' } elseif ($probeMsg -match '机构类型错误') { $probeCategory = 'company-type-guard' }; 'HTTP {0}; code={1}; category={2}' -f $probeResponse.StatusCode, $probeResult.code, $probeCategory } catch { 'Safe registration probe stopped; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
